research_question: Do the Notebook 24 metamorphic relations and declarative oracle remain stable under adversarial records designed to expose shared assumptions, priority-order dependence, context leakage, and threshold representation failures?
independence_basis: Do not reuse Notebook 23 or Notebook 24 result rows.
Generate adversarial records from a separate schema mutator, not from the subject evaluator.
Run an oracle-permutation check with independently reordered rule tables.
Preserve every disagreement, counterexample, and unresolved ambiguity.

adversarial_families.name: priority_order_collision
adversarial_families.target: rejection precedence changes classification under equivalent field failures

adversarial_families.name: threshold_numeric_representation
adversarial_families.target: decimal, rational, and floating encodings of equal threshold values

adversarial_families.name: context_history_cross_binding
adversarial_families.target: history and context fields drawn from distinct valid records

adversarial_families.name: witness_partial_enrichment
adversarial_families.target: witness appears enriched but omits one required source binding

adversarial_families.name: irrelevant_field_influence
adversarial_families.target: unexpected classification dependence on undeclared payload fields

adversarial_families.name: oracle_rule_permutation
adversarial_families.target: dependence on declarative oracle rule ordering

termination_conditions: all adversarial families and declared seeds complete
